🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · siblings · 8 slides “at eleven, you never let me hold my own bus ticket.” 📝 Slides
1. at eleven, you never let me hold my own bus ticket. 2. you kept both paper slips zipped in your coat, so they wouldn't get crumpled in my bag. 3. you dropped the coins in for both of us and took the aisle seat by the door. 4. so i just leaned against the glass, never once having to count the stops. 5. but last sunday we met on the train platform after dad's birthday in town. 6. you were so tired you kept patting your coat, convinced you had dropped the pass. 7. so i tapped my card at the gate for both of us and took the heavy bag from your hand. 8. i have the tickets tonight.
✍️ Caption
they spent years making sure we didn't miss our stop before we even knew what getting lost felt like. an older brother or sister never really turns off that radar. send this to the older sibling who still checks if you reached your front door. #siblings #oldersiblings #brotherandsister #siblinglove
